pipeline: One skinned mesh per animal; source rig preserved; animation aliasing; quantized positions and normals; embedded resources.
notes: Original anatomy-specific geometry is distinct from the supplied 85 draft shapes.
Third stages are game evolutions, not claims about biological life cycles.
First 92 published IDs, stats and owned values are preserved; 58 entries append to the dex.
Shiny body palettes use the same runtime shader as the 2D render pipeline.
